findings.recommendation: Load the token from a protected runtime secret instead of source control.

findings.evidence: The request flow gateway.handle_upload passes partner body to pickle.loads without authentication or safe decoding.
findings.impact: A crafted pickle can execute code while it is deserialized.
findings.recommendation: Use a data-only format with schema validation instead of pickle.

findings.evidence: apply_hook concatenates hook_name and manifest name into command and invokes subprocess.run with shell=True.
findings.impact: An attacker can inject shell syntax through request-controlled fields.
findings.recommendation: Select hooks from an allowlist and invoke subprocess with an argument list and shell disabled.

findings.evidence: open_export appends attacker-controlled requested_name to EXPORT_ROOT/account and reads it without containment validation.
findings.impact: A caller can read files outside its export directory with traversal components.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the candidate and require it to remain below the per-account directory.

findings.evidence: read_latest follows the privileged latest symlink without verifying that its resolved target remains inside the account directory.
findings.impact: A symlink can redirect a tenant read to an unrelated file.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the link and enforce an account-directory containment check before reading.

observations.proof: authorize interpolates login_name and pin into statement before sqlite executes it.
observations.remedy: Use SQL placeholders and pass both values separately.

Console redirect helper.content:
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

DEFAULT_URL = "https://console.internal.example/"
ALLOWED_ORIGIN = "https://console.internal.example"

def safe_redirect(next_url: str) -> str:
    parsed = urlsplit(next_url)
    if (parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname == "console.internal.example"
            and parsed.port is None and parsed.username is None and parsed.password is None):
        return next_url
    return DEFAULT_URL
